The restructure moves most of the code, and nothing today would show that a move changed behaviour: there is no CI, no pinned outputs, scratch tests run by default, and build artefacts are tracked.
We want the repository cleaned, a build that fails on warnings, CI on every push, a fast and a slow test set, and golden runs that pin today's outputs so every later ticket can show it changed structure only.

Its responsibilities are:
* Repository hygiene: tracked build artefacts, scratch tests, stray files, run output location
* Build settings and CI
* Golden runs of the commands whose outputs the paper and the saved runs depend on

Every ticket in this milestone should be a change of structure only, checked by the golden runs, because the results in RESEARCH.md were produced by today's code and must stay reproducible.

Order: hygiene; build and CI; golden runs.

Done when: CI runs the fast tests and the golden runs on every push, and both pass on the unchanged code.

Read first: RESEARCH.md "Toward general synthesis", README "Extending"
